title: A quotient of a Noetherian local ring by an ideal containing a power of the maximal ideal is Artinian local
statement: Let $C$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, let $N\ge1$ be an integer and $K\subseteq C$ an ideal with $\mathfrak m^N\subseteq K\subseteq\mathfrak m$. Then $C/K$ is an Artinian local ring (every descending chain of ideals is eventually constant) whose maximal ideal is $\mathfrak m/K$, and $(\mathfrak m/K)^N=0$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line per clause: for C Noetherian local and K with m^N ⊆ K ⊆ m, m is a minimal prime over K (any prime containing K contains m^N hence m), so the lemma gives IsArtinianRing (C ⧸ K); C ⧸ K is nontrivial (K ⊆ m ≠ C) and local by IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/Basic.lean:115) applied to Ideal.Quotient.mk K, its maximal ideal is the image m/K of m (the image of the maximal ideal under a surjection of local rings), and (m/K)^N = image of m^N = 0
